defects.justification: service.go imports modernc.org/sqlite but go.mod has no require directive for it (only `module` and `go 1.22`) and there is no go.sum, so the build is not reproducible and the driver version is unpinned.
http.ListenAndServe uses a zero-value http.Server with no ReadHeaderTimeout/ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout/IdleTimeout, so slow-loris clients can hold connections open indefinitely.

Every new event unconditionally overwrites the order status, with no state-transition check, so a late or out-of-order delivery (e.g. a retried payment.failed arriving after payment.succeeded, or payment.succeeded after refund.created) moves a paid or refunded order back to failed/paid; the event amount is also never checked against the stored order amount.
GET /orders/{id} has no authentication at all, so anyone who can reach the service can enumerate order ids and read their amounts and payment status.
writeJSON discards the error from json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v), so failed response writes are silently lost.
